Class ThematicShaderRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.ThematicShaderRenderer
public class ThematicShaderRenderer extends Object

ThematicShaderRenderer

Domain-specific thematic shaders and raster color calculations for H3 cells across socioeconomic, ecological, epidemiological, and geophysical indicator layers.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
